+## Waterjet Profile workflow (#1883)
+
+This workflow requires the Waterjet Profile implementation in #1883 (PR #3058).
+That implementation is not yet on `main`.
+There is no built-in waterjet. Mount a `.mch` file whose machine `kind` is
+`"waterjet"` with `load_machine { "path": "waterjet.mch" }`.
+Add a nozzle with `kind: "waterjet"` and `rpm: 0`. Its diameter is the kerf width.
+
+For a plate model spanning Z = 0 to 5 mm, call these MCP tools in order.
+Use the actual machine file and plate model. Adapt the heights, leads, tab
+positions and cutting parameters to the part and machine.
+
+```text
+load_machine { "path": "waterjet.mch" }
+add_tool { "name": "Nozzle", "definition": { "kind": "waterjet", "diameter": 0.8, "corner_r": 0, "tip_angle": 0, "pitch": 0, "nose_radius": 0, "width": 0, "flute_len": 10, "shank_d": 30, "shank_len": 100, "holder_d": 0, "holder_len": 0, "material_group": "mild steel", "rpm": 0, "feed": 2500, "center_cutting": false } }
+import_model { "path": "plate.stl", "name": "plate" }
+add_operation { "kind": "Waterjet Profile", "name": "Jet1", "tool": "Nozzle", "source": "plate", "params": { "clearance_z": 25, "top_z": 5, "bottom_z": 0, "kerf": null, "control_comp": false, "reversed": false, "lead": "arc", "lead_in": 4, "lead_out": 3, "open_side": "center", "tabs": { "count": 1, "width": 2, "at": [[20, 0]] }, "feed": 250, "pierce_time": 2.5, "abrasive_delay": 0.5, "linearize": 0.01 } }
+generate { "name": "Jet1" }
+```
+
+Use `list_operation_types` for the complete parameter fields and defaults.
+`kerf: null` uses the nozzle diameter. `control_comp` selects controller
+compensation; `false` uses computer compensation. `reversed` reverses the cut.
+`lead` accepts `arc` or `straight`; `lead_in` and `lead_out` set their lengths.
+`open_side` accepts `center`, `left` or `right` for an open chain.
+`tabs` supplies `count`, `width` and explicit XY positions in `at`.
+Lengths and the optional `linearize` tolerance are in mm; `feed` is in mm/min.
+`linearize: null` keeps arcs.
+
+`pierce_time` and `abrasive_delay` are in seconds. They appear in path notes
+only until #1882 adds post support. Inspect the notes returned by `generate`.
+No post serves a waterjet yet. Do not use a milling or plasma post for this path.
+The implementation in #1883 pins this workflow in
+`crates/app/tests/mcp_waterjet.rs`. Those tests run headlessly, not on a machine.
+

+# Provenance: original documentation contracts for the Waterjet Profile MCP workflow (#3048).
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import unittest
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+
+
+class WaterjetWorkflowDocumentation(unittest.TestCase):
+    def workflow(self):
+        skill = (ROOT / ".claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md").read_text()
+        heading = "## Waterjet Profile workflow (#1883)"
+        self.assertTrue(heading in skill, "The MCP guide must document Waterjet Profile")
+        start = skill.index(heading)
+        end = skill.index("## Plasma Profile workflow", start)
+        return skill[start:end]
+
+    def commands(self):
+        return {verb: json.loads(args) for verb, args in re.findall(
+            r"^(load_machine|add_tool|add_operation) (\{.*\})$",
+            self.workflow(), re.MULTILINE)}
+
+    def test_waterjet_workflow_documents_machine_and_nozzle(self):
+        commands = self.commands()
+        self.assertTrue(commands["load_machine"]["path"].endswith(".mch"))
+        self.assertNotIn("builtin", commands["load_machine"])
+        tool = commands["add_tool"]
+        self.assertEqual(tool["name"], "Nozzle")
+        self.assertEqual(tool["definition"]["kind"], "waterjet")
+        self.assertGreater(tool["definition"]["diameter"], 0)
+        self.assertEqual(tool["definition"]["rpm"], 0)
+
+    def test_waterjet_workflow_documents_operation_parameters(self):
+        operation = self.commands()["add_operation"]
+        self.assertEqual(operation["kind"], "Waterjet Profile")
+        self.assertEqual(operation["tool"], "Nozzle")
+        params = operation["params"]
+        expected = {"kerf", "control_comp", "reversed", "lead", "lead_in",
+                    "lead_out", "open_side", "tabs", "feed", "pierce_time",
+                    "abrasive_delay", "linearize"}
+        self.assertTrue(expected <= params.keys(), expected - params.keys())
+        self.assertTrue({"count", "width", "at"} <= params["tabs"].keys())
+        self.assertIn(params["lead"], ("arc", "straight"))
+        self.assertIn(params["open_side"], ("center", "left", "right"))
+        workflow = self.workflow()
+        for value in ("arc", "straight", "center", "left", "right"):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                self.assertIn(f"`{value}`", workflow)
+
+    def test_waterjet_workflow_documents_availability_and_limits(self):
+        workflow = " ".join(self.workflow().split())
+        self.assertRegex(workflow, r"(?i)no built-in waterjet")
+        self.assertRegex(workflow, r"(?i)diameter.{0,40}kerf|kerf.{0,40}diameter")
+        for term in ("pierce_time", "abrasive_delay", "notes", "#1882",
+                     "crates/app/tests/mcp_waterjet.rs"):
+            with self.subTest(term=term):
+                self.assertIn(term, workflow)
+        self.assertRegex(workflow, r"(?i)no.{0,30}post.{0,30}waterjet")
+        self.assertRegex(workflow, r"(?i)requires.{0,80}#1883")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+## #3048 - Document the Waterjet Profile MCP workflow
+
+**Chosen:** Add the Waterjet Profile workflow before the Plasma Profile workflow.
+Show the machine file, complete nozzle definition and operation parameters.
+State that the example requires #1883 (PR #3058), which is not yet on main.
+Keep the current limits explicit: timings appear in notes, and no post serves waterjet.
+
+**Why:** Agents need the tool calls and parameter keys for the new operation.
+The example follows the pending implementation's MCP test and parameter DTO.
+The availability statement prevents agents from assuming that main supports it.
+
+**Dropped:** Do not add runtime code or a waterjet post in this documentation change.
+Do not use a milling or plasma post as a substitute.
+Use standalone Python documentation tests, as the skill already does.
+Do not add a Rust dependency for a text contract.
+
+**Cost to change later:** Update the example and its documentation tests when #1883
+or #1882 changes the operation contract or post support.
